description_en: After you create a Simple Application Server database service instance, you can view and modify its parameters
description_zh: 轻量数据库服务创建后，您可以查看数据库的参数信息，或者根据业务需求，修改数据库参数
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open modify-database-instance-parameter --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --database-instance-id db-38263fa955774501a2ae1bdaed6f0000 --parameters delayed_insert_timeout_:_600_,_max_length_for_sort_data_:_2048 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDatabaseInstanceParameter

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the database instance. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html to view the supported Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the database instance
parameters.name: database_instance_id

parameters.help_en: A JSON string that specifies the database parameters and their values. The value for each parameter must be a string. Format: `{"ParameterName1":"Value1","ParameterName2":"Value2",...}`
parameters.help_zh: 数据库参数及其值的JSON串，参数的值为字符串类型。格式：{"参数名称1":"参数值1","参数名称2":"参数值2"...}
parameters.name: parameters

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to restart the database for the parameter changes to take effect. Valid values:

true: Forces a restart. Set this to true if any modified parameter requires a restart to take effect. Otherwise, the change will not take effect.

false: Do not force a restart.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
修改参数是否重启数据库，取值范围：

true：强制重启（若修改的参数当中，有需要重启的参数，则必须传入true，否则修改将不生效）。
false：不强制重启。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force_restart

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token to ensure request idempotence. You must ensure that the token is unique for each request. It can contain only ASCII characters and cannot be longer than 64 characters. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token
